preregistration.budget_derivation: D_safe = prior WEAK1000 mean combined distance on fixed192 contexts; D_hard=4*D_safe (2x RMS behavior budget), both chosen before any new rollout; no retuning
preregistration.execution: NPU0 sequential BASELINE then ADAPTIVE at each stage; both use production resume semantics, partial episodes discarded/reset at matched stage boundaries
preregistration.RL_retention_primary: sum per-Actor-update Q1 expected score AFTER minus BEFORE step on identical batch and unchanged current Critic during that step; does not include Critic weight changes
preregistration.RL_retention_secondary: fixed140K Critic, identical fixed192 evaluation contexts, current Actor gain vs140K divided by matched BASELINE gain
